meta.title: Recreate Order: Change the quantity in the pop-up
gaps: Verify after creation that the original event still shows Quantity Requested = 10
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify after creation that the original event still shows Quantity Requested = 10

steps.note: Open the existing closed RFQ prepared for this case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order pop-up.
Verify the Recreate Order pop-up opened with its Product Sheet section.
Verify the expected recreate configuration is present.
Verify the delivery-date option is present in the pop-up.
Verify the scheduling option is present in the pop-up.
Change the requested quantity in the recreate pop-up.
Assert the pop-up retains the changed quantity before submission.
Verify the recreated order submission did not produce an application error.
Verify the resulting recreated event displays its quantity from the API-backed event state.
